subject: Urgent room change for the huddle
text: Hi, I need to move the project huddle from ten thirty to two fifteen because I just realized the old calendar invite was showing the wrong start time. I had penciled us into the glass room, but the room actually opens at two, and I already sent a note to facilities asking whether they can leave the door unlocked for a little while. If that does not work, we can use the standing desk area near the supply closet instead. I know the morning was supposed to be when most people are still online, so I am sorry if this makes things awkward for anyone with calls after lunch and a short buffer before their next task. The client update can also be trimmed, so we do not overrun. I will keep the agenda to three questions, unless someone needs more than a few minutes to explain a blocker. I tried to shift it to two forty, but that clashes with the design review, so this seems the cleanest compromise for now. Please reply with a quick thumbs up, thumbs down, or a better option before noon, because I need to confirm the room by one. If you do not mind, could you also pass this along to anyone who missed the chat message? Please flag immediately if your schedule completely falls apart, and I will do my best to rearrange the room or split the huddle. I appreciate it.
